figure: Figure 9 -- AlignScore threshold re-sweep after the splitter fix (Edit 1 + Edit 3)
paper_section: 9.4.4, Edit 3: re-calibrating THRESHOLD after the splitter fix
description: Real 10-file sweep (prim1.txt, prim10.txt-prim18.txt), hallucination-type labels only, every claim scored once by AlignScore with Edit 1's clinical-note-aware splitter applied (Modules/old/alignscore_checker.py) -- a single model pass, not one pass per threshold candidate -- then each threshold tried against those cached scores. This is Edit 3 only: the splitter fix (Edit 1) plus this re-sweep, with Edit 2's adjacency-pair bridging (attempted, made things worse, not adopted -- see main.tex) and the later d/p pair-chunking work both excluded, matching what this checker's state actually was when Edit 3 was written up.
source: Modules/old/alignscore_checker.py's own THRESHOLD comment block -- the sweep results are preserved there verbatim (this file's data_jsons JSON had been overwritten at some point by a later, unrelated d/p pair-chunking threshold sweep; restored from that code comment, the only surviving record of the original run).
